description:
The Sundarbans is home to one of the most elusive and powerful predators—the Royal Bengal Tiger. As the only mangrove-dwelling tiger in the world, it has adapted to an ever-changing landscape of tides, dense forests, and shifting river channels. But beyond its fearsome reputation, this tiger holds deep cultural significance, revered and worshipped by those who coexist with it.

How does this majestic beast survive in such extreme conditions? And what does its presence mean for the 4.5 million people who share its habitat? Watch to uncover the mysteries of the Sundarbans Tiger.

#RoundglassSustain #SundarbansTiger #RoyalBengalTiger #WildlifeConservation #MangroveForest #BigCats

About Us: Roundglass Sustain is a social impact initiative passionate about protecting India’s wildlife and its habitats. Through beautiful films, photography, and conversations, we bring India’s wildlife and ecosystem to life.  

We work with scientists, conservationists, and communities to create content that’s fun, easy to understand, and inspiring. Our goal is to help everyone feel closer to nature and take small steps to protect it via our storytelling that supports conservation efforts by raising awareness and helping protect wildlife.
